digest.component_or_area: plan review criteria registry and guide validation
propositions: A packaged prose guide can cite criterion ids that later change in the registry without any gate detecting the divergence, causing the guide's claims to silently become inaccurate.
No systematic mechanism currently couples criterion id citations in prose guides to their authoritative rubric texts, leaving 19 of 20 cited criteria in the plan guide with no parity coupling.
The gate must fail visibly and force re-verification when a cited criterion's text changes, converting invisible semantic drift into a forced manual re-pin.
Citation extraction must be vocabulary-only (matching closed criterion ids at word boundaries) rather than markup-dependent, so ordinary prose edits do not break the gate.
The pin manifest must be generated over packaged built-ins only and must not be affected by project-level criteria routing overlays.
The gate must run in CI without adding a new workflow step by composing into the existing validate-routing step.
